import fs from 'node:fs';import path from 'node:path';import crypto from 'node:crypto';import assert from 'node:assert/strict';import {spawnSync}from'node:child_process';
const [batchFile,id,turnArg,label,startHeading,endHeading,reason,flagName,markerArg]=process.argv.slice(2),marker='C:/Users/Admin/.codex/worktrees/html-guide-acceptance/reviewer/corrections/0-1-31/normal-execution-pause.flag',hash=b=>crypto.createHash('sha256').update(b).digest('hex');assert.equal(flagName,'--pause-file');assert.equal(path.resolve(markerArg),path.resolve(marker));assert.ok(!fs.existsSync(marker),'Global pause: no quote or choose');const batch=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(batchFile)),a=batch.cases[id].attempts.at(-1),sourceTurn=Number(turnArg),t=a.turns[sourceTurn-1];assert.equal(t.transportStatus,'COMPLETE');assert.equal(a.selection,null);const raw=fs.readFileSync(t.outputFile),text=raw.toString('utf8'),start=text.indexOf(startHeading),end=text.indexOf(endHeading,start+startHeading.length);assert.ok(start>=0&&end>start&&text.indexOf(startHeading,start+startHeading.length)<0,'Exact manually read single heading');const excerpt=text.slice(start,end);assert.ok(excerpt.includes(label)&&excerpt.includes('任务')&&excerpt.includes('理解问题'));assert.ok(reason,'Human operator confirms actual audience in heading; not auto role inference');const quote=path.join(path.dirname(t.outputFile),'manual-selection-turn-'+sourceTurn+'.txt');assert.ok(!fs.existsSync(marker),'Pause rechecked before quote');fs.writeFileSync(quote,excerpt,{flag:'wx'});assert.ok(!fs.existsSync(marker),'Pause rechecked before actual choose');const r=spawnSync(process.execPath,[path.join(batch.reviewerRoot,'harness.mjs'),'choose','--batch',batchFile,'--variant',id,'--turn',String(sourceTurn),'--label',label,'--quote-file',quote],{shell:false,windowsHide:true,encoding:'utf8'});process.stdout.write(r.stdout);process.stderr.write(r.stderr);assert.equal(r.status,0,'Actual choose failed: preserve, no retry');const audit={recordedAt:new Date().toISOString(),operator:'behavior_b',canonicalSha:batch.source.canonicalSha,canonicalTree:batch.source.canonicalTree,packageVersion:batch.packageVersion,variant:id,attemptId:a.attemptId,actualUuid:a.threadId,sourceTurn,actualLabel:label,actualTargetHeading:startHeading,actualNextTargetHeading:endHeading,sourceOutput:t.outputFile,sourceOutputSha256:hash(raw),singleTripletExactExcerpt:quote,singleTripletExactExcerptSha256:hash(Buffer.from(excerpt)),actualTargetHeadingLine:text.slice(0,start).split(/\r?\n/).length,operatorReason:reason,method:'MANUAL_ACTUAL_HEADING_AND_SINGLE_COMPLETE_TRIPLET',actualAudienceInHeading:true,literalReaderLabelNotRequiredByPublicContract:true,frozenAidLiteralPrecheckNotInvoked:true,frozenHarnessChooseUsedUnchanged:true,requiredPauseFile:marker,pauseAbsentBeforeQuoteAndChoose:true,automaticLabelInference:false,scopeOrQuestionNumeralsNotUsed:true,chooseAccepted:true,modelReceivesLabelOnly:true,noSemanticGrade:true};const file=path.join(path.dirname(t.outputFile),'manual-title-audit.json');fs.writeFileSync(file,JSON.stringify(audit,null,2)+'\n',{flag:'wx'});console.log(JSON.stringify({manualAudit:file,variant:id,actualLabel:label,sourceTurn,noSemanticGrade:true}));
